summary: Argument coding: zero and l-marked patients occur with objects and people. Body-part contact may be l-marked; b- marks a holding location or instrument, m- marks a source or grip point. L-agent suffixes and patient marking must be distinguished. The teacher mədwoli, feminine-agent mədle at 29/454 and 56/59, and reciprocal mədla at 68/55 remain uncertain.

Aspect: Preterit-wa midowayle and dmidə́nnewa, ko-Preterit kmədla, and Detransitive Preterit mido/mid add previously missing boxes. They do not require additional meanings. kmədla contrasts locally with Infectum kmaydola.

The Detransitive ranges from potential extraction (inherited dagger) to actual removal of a child or ring, weapon handling, and income. Money and weapon participants extend the same taking event. The inherited Detransitive Infinitiv contains an active action noun; retain its filing without interpreting it as suppressed-agent voice.

Idiomatic phrases use abstract nouns with taking: measures, opinion, shape, quality, strength, appointment. Search of supplied glossary examples and relevant nouns found no duplicate headwords; inherited rental and diploma idioms remain unchanged.

Repeated objectless myd before an action, plus explicit d- preparation and l-activity complements, motivates sense 5. Some tokens with a nearby recoverable object remain ambiguous; this construction is machine-proposed, not a claim that every narrative myd is auxiliary.
Routine counts in this input: none requiring extra occurrence decisions.
Jan contains interviews, narrative and editorial discussion as well as written prose. Abstract noun objects are frequent, but their presence alone does not establish lexical polysemy.
Argument coding includes bare nouns, l-marked human and inanimate patients, explicit m-sources and l-benefactives. At Jan 3.14/132 l-u faṭəryarxo doubles the actor; it is not the decision object.

summary: nehmen includes receiving money, obtaining a reward or compensation, collecting liquids, removing interior wood, and taking people along. These participant and context differences do not establish new senses.

Objectless initiation is reinforced by repeated ʕwədle, composing a poem, and d-writing. No new initiating sense is proposed; the rifle clause and priestly-duty ellipsis remain less secure.

Acquired themes include freedom, permission, legal authority, information, a surname, residence, assistance and cultural material. Fees and in-kind remuneration continue the round-1 payment extension. These participant changes do not each require a new sense.

The cultural “skins” versus “essence” contrast is a literary metaphor. The branch drawing strength from the vine supports the round-1 ḥaylo m- collocation with the noun quwwe; it is not proposed again.
